data.title: Ethereum ETFs attract $103.9M inflows as Bitcoi... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) led crypto fund inflows last week with $103.9 million, marking a third consecutive week of strong demand. Bitcoin ETFs saw declining inflows, dropping to $33.79 million amid two days of significant outflows. Meanwhile, Hyperliquid ETFs experienced their second straight week of outflows, losing $8.6 million and seeing assets fall about 18% from a recent peak. This trend highlights steady interest in Ethereum ETFs while investors remain cautious about newer products like Hyperliquid. The coming weeks will reveal if Ethereum continues to dominate or if Bitcoin ETFs regain momentum.
